rows.name: Steakhouse Financial
farm_steps: Open Steakhouse Financial's own site and its docs or points page, and confirm on that page what counts as activity before you spend anything. Cost: free to check, and never pay a fee to qualify. Time: 20 minutes of reading.
Use a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm on Base, and keep its seed phrase offline. Cost: about $3 of gas to fund the wallet. Time: 10 minutes.
Deposit $150 of USDC into a Steakhouse Financial vault on Base and keep the vault shares in the same wallet. Cost: $150 of capital and about $11 of round-trip gas. Time: 20 minutes to set up.
Make one more qualifying action: Make one swap or one small deposit in a second pool on Base so two contracts show activity. Cost: about $6 of gas. Time: 15 minutes.

Keep the position and one action a week open for at least 30 days, so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot of the protocol's TVL. Cost: the $150 stays in the position, and about $2 of gas a week. Time: 30 days, 10 minutes a week.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own rewards page and claim only from the link that page publishes; then write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log. Cost: no fee to check or to claim, and nothing to keep the log. Time: 15 minutes to claim and log.
